title: expectrail.explanation/v1
description: A written explanation of one findings record (#264), for the evidence viewer. It decides nothing. Expectrail, not the author, fills decision and recordSha256 (expectrail.explanation.from_answer). Every point cites evidence ids from the record: a finding's id, or check:<spec>@<route>. The viewer shows it only when expectrail.explanation.check finds nothing wrong: the same decision as the verifier's, the record it was written for, only known ids, every stated verdict equal to the record's, no number that is not in the evidence it cites, and every passing or failing word backed by the recorded after verdict of every cited id and by a stated after verdict. A decision word must match the run and every cited after verdict (accept requires pass, reject requires fail). A name does not exempt a word from these checks. Otherwise it is withheld and the page says why.

recorded.description: true when the answer was replayed from a recording, not asked live

says.description: The verdicts this point states, per cited id: what the record must say for the point to be shown.
